description.zh: 上游 kokonutui 的真实组件 v0-button 在本地沙箱中的实际渲染；1 个可调参数：name。
description.en: Open in v0 button that sends a component registry JSON to v0.dev for instant editing, built with React, the shadcn Button, and Tailwind CSS. Rendered from the original source at commit 4d497b7b03f02ffd07225e638c0b9ace3f892dbb.
